title: Great Organizer
text: Great Organizer. This RC holder may be great for some RC’s, mine are very tall, and tend to stand way too high.  I now use mine to hold the small RC’s, glasses, scissors, pens and paper on my chairside table.  It keeps everything neat, organized, and handy.
